name: City Council Special Meeting - Mayoral Installation/City Council Reorganization
agenda_text:
City Council of Monterey Park
  The City Council Acting on Behalf of the Successor Agency of the Former Redevelopment
 Agency, the Housing Authority, the Monterey Park Financing Authority and the Monterey Park
  Geologic Hazard Abatement District Agenda

  Special Meeting
  Monterey Park City Hall Council Chambers
  320 W. Newmark Avenue, Monterey Park, CA 91754

  Tuesday, September 16, 2025
  6:00 PM
  Mission Statement
The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  Land Acknowledgment
We would like to acknowledge that the land we inhabit today was once known as Tovangaar, the home
 of the Gabrieleño-Tongva people. We show our respect to the Gabrieleño-Tongva people, as well as
  all Indigenous people, past, present, and future, and honor their labor as original caretakers of this
land. We commit to uplifting the Gabrieleño-Tongva people, invite you to acknowledge the history, and
  join us in caring for this land.

General Information
Documents related to an Agenda item are available to the public in the City Clerk’s Office located at
320 West Newmark Avenue, Monterey Park, CA 91754, during normal business hours and
at wwww.montereypark.ca.gov/agendas.

The public may watch the meeting live on the city’s cable channel MPKTV (AT&T U-verse, channel 99
or Charter Communications, channel 182) or by visiting the city’s website
at http://www.montereypark.ca.gov/133/City-Council-Meeting-Videos.

Per the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting,
please call City Hall at (626) 307-1359 for reasonable accommodation at least 8 hours before a
meeting. Council Chambers are wheelchair accessible.

Public Participation
You may speak up to 5 minutes on an/each Agenda item. You may combine up to 2 minutes of time
with another person’s speaking. No person may speak more than a total of 10 minutes. The Mayor
and City Council may change the amount of time allowed for speakers. Written Communication will be
accepted up to 3 hours before the meeting by completing an online form
at www.montereypark.ca.gov/writtencomm.

Pursuant to Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the public may address the City Council only on
 matters listed on this Agenda. No other public comment will be accepted.

minutes_text:
72-282

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Financing Authority (MPFA)
  Housing Authority (MPHA)
  Geologic Hazard Abatement District (GHAD)
  Successor Agency (SA)
  Special Meeting
  September 16, 2025
The City Council, the Financing Authority (MPFA), the Housing Authority (MPHA), the Geologic
Hazard Abatement District (GHAD), and the Successor Agency (SA) of the City of Monterey
Park held a Special Meeting of the Council in the Council Chamber, located at 320 West
Newmark Avenue in the City of Monterey Park, Tuesday, September 16, 2025, at 6:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  Mayor Ngo called the meeting to order at 6:16 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  The Monterey Park Police Color Guard led the flag salute. Pledge of Allegiance presented
  by Civic Superstars Liliana Kazachka, Alexander Kazachki, Mayah Kazachka and Milenah
  Kazachka.

3.  Roll Call
  City Clerk Maychelle Yee called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez, Thomas Wong, Elizabeth
  Yang
  Council Members Absent: None.

  Also Present:
  City Treasurer Amy Lee
  City Manager Inez Alvarez
  City Attorney Karl Berger
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Director of Human Resources and Risk Management Christine Tomikawa
  Director of Community Development Timothy Hou
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Acting City Librarian LV Frazier
  Director of Public Works Shawn Igoe
  Police Chief Scott Weise
  Fire Chief Jason Hing
  Deputy City Clerk Cindy Trang

  Virtually present:
  None.

4.  Agenda Revisions and Additions
  None.

  Mission Statement
  The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and
  opportunity, and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
   72-283
  September 16, 2025

5.  Public Communications
  Outgoing Mayor Ngo recognized special guests in attendance, which include Jeffrey
  Prang from the Los Angeles County Tax Accessors Office; State Senator Sasha Renée
  Pérez; Council Member Danny Hang from the City of West Hollywood; Jennifer Tang
  representing the office of Assembly Member Mike Fong's office; Gigi Lee representing the
  Office of Congresswoman Judy Chu; Edith Gonzalez from the Los Angeles County Office
  of Supervisors Hilda D. Solis; Mayor Kathleen Lee from the City of Alhambra; Council
  Member Noya Wang from the City of Alhambra; Council Member Samuel Kang from the
  City of Duarte; Honorable Mike Eng from the San Gabriel Valley Water District; former
  Mayors of the City of Monterey Park David Lau, Anthony Wong, Stephen Lam, Peter
  Chan and Yvonne Yiu; former Monterey Park City Clerk Theresa Amador; City Council
  Member William Go from the City of Irvine; Board Member Andrew Yam from the Garvey
  School District; former volunteers that have served the City of Monterey Park’s Boards
  and Commissions and former Board Member Sophie Wong from the Alhambra Unified
  School District.

6.  New Business

  6.A. Outgoing Address by Mayor Vinh Ngo
  Outgoing Mayor Ngo delivered his outgoing City Council address, conveying the
  accomplishments achieved during his term as Mayor. He elaborated on his
  appreciation to his fellow City Council members and City staff for their collaborative
  efforts in maintaining the City.

  The City Council presented outgoing Mayor Ngo with a plaque honoring his role as
  Mayor for the City of Monterey Park.

  6.B. Reorganization of Monterey Park City Council
  It is recommended that the City Council consider:

  1. Appointing the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem in accordance with City Council
  policy established by Resolution No. 11507; and
  2. Taking such additional, related action that may be desirable.

  Action Taken: The City Council approved the recommendation.

  Motion: Moved by Council Member Sanchez and seconded by Council
  Member Wong, motion carried by the following vote:

  Ayes: Council Members: Henry Lo , Vinh Ngo, Jose Sanchez, Thomas Wong,
  Elizabeth Yang
  Noes: Council Members: None
  Absent: Council Members: None
  Abstain: Council Members: None
  Recusal: Council Members: None
   72-284
  September 16, 2025

6.C. Mayor Pro Tem Installation of Henry Lo
  Andrew Yam, Board Member of the Garvey Unified School District, administered the
  Oath of Affirmation to Mayor Pro Tem Lo and presented him with his badge and
  business cards.

  Mayor Pro Tem Lo provided words of appreciation about his new role as Mayor Pro
  Tem and spoke about his dedication to the Monterey Park community.

6.D. Mayoral Installation of Elizabeth Yang
  Mike Eng, Treasurer and Board Member of the San Gabriel Valley Municipal Water
  District administered the Oath of Affirmation to Mayor Yang

  Mayor Yang's husband Philip Cheng; mother Kelly Yang; daughter Liliana Kazachka
  and son Alexander Kazachki presented Mayor Yang with her badge and business
  cards.

6.E. Presentations
  Presentations were heard after Agenda Item No. 6.F., Mayors Address.

  Gigi Lee from the Office of Congresswoman Judy Chu, presented certificates to City
  Council Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem Lo and Mayor Yang.

  California State Senator Sasha Renée Pérez expressed her gratitude towards the
  City Council and awarded certificates to City Council Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem
  Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Jennifer Tang from the Office of Assemblymember Mike Fong shared her
  appreciation to the City Council and bestowed certificates to Mayor Pro Tem Lo and
  Mayor Yang.

  Council Member Danny Hang of the City of West Hollywood and on behalf of the Los
  Angeles County Accessors Office of Jeffrey Prang granted certificates to Council
  Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Edith Gonzalez from the Office of Supervisors dedicated certificates to City Council
  Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Mayor Kathleen Lee and Council Member Noya Wang from the City of Alhambra
  presented certificates in appreciation to City Council Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem
  Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Mike Eng from the San Gabriel Valley Municipal Water District expressed words of
  recognition to the City Council and granted certificates to Council Member Ngo,
  Mayor Pro Tem Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Scott Kwong and Shirley Hwong of the Chinese American Citizens Alliance, San
  Gabriel Lodge awarded a plaque to Mayor Yang.
   72-285
  September 16, 2025

  Rick Eng and William Tham from the Organization of Chinese Americans (OCA),
  Greater Los Angeles bestowed certificates to Council Member Ngo, Mayor Pro Tem
  Lo and Mayor Yang.

  Stephen Lam, former Mayor of Monterey Park, shared words of gratitude and
  delivered certificates to the City Council.

  6.F. Mayor's Address
  Mayor Yang presented her Mayor's Address after Agenda Item No. 6.D.

  Mayor Yang spoke about her dedication to the City of Monterey and her goals as a
  public servant.

7.  Adjournment
  There being no further business for consideration, the meeting was adjourned at 7:37
  p.m.

  __________________
  Maychelle Yee
  City Clerk
  Approved on October 15, 2025, at the Regular City Council Meeting
